authorized_change: User requested solving acquisition blockers or switching approach without repeated manual downloads
source_policy: Download issuer earnings PDFs from official quarter pages or official URL patterns; validate issuer/quarter/date/TIFRS/consolidation, archive before numeric replay. Known frozen 2024Q4 PDFs reused from hash-verified receipts; other documents remain separate as-retrieved snapshots.
document_budget: One request per selected official URL; two workers; 30 second request bound; no repeated browser-download requests to user
management_guidance: Report exact stated numeric interval or lower bound and conditions separately; no midpoint invented; no point-MAE for non-point guidance
missing_policy: Preserve all 24 requested issuer-quarters. Do not choose a different cohort or fill missing quarters. Paired errors use both baselines and target on identical rows; require 8 targets per issuer for a complete result.
claims: Retrospective arithmetic and extraction feasibility using as-retrieved documents; not PIT validation, investable forecast accuracy, holdout performance, or alpha. Printed release dates/SEC acceptance are not certified first publication. No models fitted or trades/signals generated.
stop_policy: If this official batch cannot produce a coherent complete panel, report source feasibility failure and stop this attempt without manual-file dependency. No retry loop or parameter search.
